scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract build errors from a large multi-target failure

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences), not just the first handful
Observed errors concentrated in HotReload test files

scenarios.reasoning: Accurate, complete, well-quantified answer covering all rubric points plus actionable root-cause analysis and fixes. Minor early tool-path fumbling (missing temp files, hung find) cost a few steps but the agent recovered cleanly by querying the binlog directly.
